Running Python code interactively: # Let me check the fvar table of TestGVARNine to verify axis count
import struct

with open('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/font-corpus/TestGVARNine.ttf', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

num_tables = struct.unpack('>H', data[4:6])[0]
for i in range(num_tables):
    off = 12 + i * 16
    tag = data[off:off+4].decode('latin1')
    offset = struct.unpack('>I', data[off+8:off+12])[0]
    length = struct.unpack('>I', data[off+12:off+16])[0]
    if tag == 'fvar':
        fvar_data = data[offset:offset+length]
        print(f"fvar: len={length}")
        print(f"  version={hex(struct.unpack('>I', fvar_data[0:4])[0])}")
        print(f"  offsetToData={struct.unpack('>H', fvar_data[4:6])[0]}")
        print(f"  countSizePairs={struct.unpack('>H', fvar_data[6:8])[0]}")
        print(f"  axisCount={struct.unpack('>H', fvar_data[8:10])[0]}")
        print(f"  axisSize={struct.unpack('>H', fvar_data[10:12])[0]}")
        print(f"  instanceCount={struct.unpack('>H', fvar_data[12:14])[0]}")
        print(f"  instanceSize={struct.unpack('>H', fvar_data[14:16])[0]}")
        # Check axis records
        axis_offset = 16
        for a in range(struct.unpack('>H', fvar_data[8:10])[0]):
            axis = fvar_data[axis_offset:axis_offset+20]
            print(f"  axis {a}: tag={axis[0:4].decode('latin1')}")
            axis_offset += 20
        # Check instance records
        inst_offset = axis_offset
        for i in range(struct.unpack('>H', fvar_data[12:14])[0]):
            inst = fvar_data[inst_offset:inst_offset+struct.unpack('>H', fvar_data[14:16])[0]]
            print(f"  instance {i}: strid={struct.unpack('>H', inst[0:2])[0]}")
            inst_offset += struct.unpack('>H', fvar_data[14:16])[0]
